name: hexnote-3d
features: Geodesic hex sphere renders in 3D, and tapping a hex opens a note to write, save, delete or close.
Holding a hex starts a link to another hex, and links draw as arcs.
Switch between first person, orbit and exploded space views.
Retract all hexes and clear all links work, and note and link counts update.
Notes save in the browser, and export and import back them up.
